recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Treat FHIR-22113 as historically applied and now intentionally represented by Device.name/display; use a new OO work-group decision for any future change to the Device display-name model.
issue_request: FHIR-22113 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5 to add Device.displayName string [0..1], a concise default display name for a Device when referenced, possibly drawn from Device.deviceName or another simple name.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged a7f2575 Device updates commit listed FHIR-22113 and added Device.displayName to the old Device spreadsheet source as a 0..1 string with the requested definition. The element was later carried into StructureDefinition source during source migration before being superseded.
additional_context: FHIR-39162 was a later Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 ballot decision to remove Device.displayName and update the Device name backbone with value/type/display semantics. FHIR-46397 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 decision to remove Device.displayName as redundant with Device.name.display, and a prior combined-branch FHIR-46397 reconciliation commit removed remaining stale commented-out Device.displayName source. FHIR-55372 and FHIR-54320 then removed modifier classification from Device.name.display without changing its preferred-display-name role.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current active Device source already contains Device.name, Device.name.value, Device.name.type, Device.name.display, and the dev-1 uniqueness constraint, while no active Device.displayName element remains; re-adding Device.displayName would contradict later final work-group decisions.

Applied R6 decision removed modifier status from Device.name.display while preserving it as display-preference metadata.
